mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( id, created_date, created_by, updated_date, updated_by, remove_flag, description, login_name, user_type, `status`, name_ch, name_en, major ) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), NOW(), '0', NOW(), '0', 0, st.description, st.employee_id, 'TEACHER', 1, st.`name`, st.display_name, st.department FROM sys_ad_teacher_temp st LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.login_name = st.employee_id AND su.user_type = 'TEACHER' WHERE st.batch_number = #{batchNumber} AND su.login_name IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user su, sys_ad_teacher_temp st SET su.updated_date = NOW(), su.description = st.description, su.remove_flag = 0, su.name_ch = st.`name`, su.name_en = st.display_name, su.major = st.department WHERE su.user_type = 'TEACHER' AND st.batch_number = #{batchNumber} AND su.login_name = st.employee_id
